//: Static, and deliberately not a framework. The landing page is one
self-contained file whose only external references are a CDN copy of
three.js and Google Fonts, so there is nothing for a bundler to resolve
and nothing for a server to render. Vercel was serving nothing because it
found a private pnpm monorepo, ran `tsc --build`, and got no web output.
The build command regenerates the page from its source rather than
trusting the committed copy — build.mjs imports only node:fs, so no
install is needed, and a deploy cannot ship a page that drifted from the
gl.css and gl.js it came from.
The operator console is NOT here. It needs a SQLite ledger opened with
synchronous = FULL on a disk that survives a restart, and Vercel's
filesystem is ephemeral. Putting it here would give it a ledger that
forgets what it paid. It deploys to Render; see docs/DEPLOY.md.
installCommand: echo 'no dependencies: the page build uses node:fs only'

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
